purpose: Define domain-specific constraints, defaults and derived semantics as explicit overlays that may restrict/compose substrate use but never silently rewrite Universal Module primitive meaning.

value.rule_rule: Each machine-significant domain rule has an explicit identity.
value.restriction_rule: Domain may add constraints/restrictions to substrate use.
value.rewrite_rule: Primitive meaning cannot be silently redefined under the same primitive identity.
value.default_rule: Domain defaults are explicit and do not become global Universal Module defaults.
value.derived_rule: Derived domain concepts preserve source refs/provenance.
value.authority_rule: Domain rule has no AccessCore authority unless explicitly referenced by policy.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

references.purpose: Overlay specializes an exact domain composition.
